status: Full/light static geometry, 745-step source gate, preflight and bounded published desktop/mobile validation passed.
visual_findings: West foreground now has the tall asymmetric gable, lower rear unhipped range, two broad low front lights, two upper slits and four regular rear lights.
Turret center aligns exactly to the west-gable apex in true west orthographic projection. Perspective still shows depth/parallax; no geometry was hidden for captures.
North windows no longer protrude through the eaves; the grazing view shows a continuous roof/cornice.
North stable door carries5x2upper glazing per leaf and lower vertical boards, while measured opening width is preserved; loft is a deep opening with relieving arch and stone appendage.
Dormer broad dark opening has no center post or shade; square projecting hip, finial and side supports remain.

South/courtyard final views show no roof holes, floating windows or exposed wall/roof gaps. Rear roof is asymmetric in cross-section to retain court window clearance, as recorded by the implementation.
The initially floating light ridge cap was corrected. The exact shipped light north-detail now follows the sloped roof, and emitted cap vertices pass the independent host-envelope regression.
limitations: Reference image(2) is an owner-directed reconstruction target, not a surveyed elevation.
CIE overcast render scene adds neutral ground and lighting only; no mesh/material retouching.
Render review supports visible corrections, not a quantitative claim of photographic perfection.
